notes: Recall question, answered from my own knowledge before reading the solution: the strong nuclear force acts over a few femtometres, so its range is of the order of 10⁻¹⁵ m, printed option 3. Both step lines are true and the femtometre-to-metre conversion is correct. The single common_mistakes entry is sound: the weak nuclear force range is of the order of 10⁻¹⁶ m, which is printed option 2, it is one order smaller than the strong-force range as the entry states, and confusing the two forces is a real error on a recall item like this. Printed options 1 and 4 are left unaccounted for, which the brief does not require. difficulty easy and mistake_type_hint concept both fit a one-line recall item whose only trap is which force is meant.
